item.title: Pop Off! – "Andor" Episodes, Pt. 1 - The Ithacan
item.description: Host Ethan Kaufman and senior Ray Milburn dive into a discussion on the anatomy of fascism and the spark of rebellion as they begin ranking their top seven favorite episodes of Tony Gilroy's "Star Wars" prequel series, "Andor."

item.title: How IC Sports – Women in Sports - The Ithacan
item.description: Host Johnny Lisi brings on sophomores Molly Golden and CeCe Gabriel for a conversation on how their gender has affected their respective journeys in collegiate athletics.

item.title: Q&A: Cinema and photography alum screens award-winning feature at Cinemapolis - The Ithacan
item.description: “Stationed at Home,” the debut feature film written and directed by Daniel V. Masciari ’15, premieres at Cinemapolis on The Commons on March 19. The screening will be followed by a Q&A with the filmmaker and several cast members.

item.title: Behind the win: IC Dining’s flaming hot victory at Chili Cook-Off - The Ithacan
item.description: Ithaca residents emerged from their dreary hibernation March 7 for Downtown Ithaca’s 28th Annual Chili Cook-Off, a day of warm weather and fiery mouths. For the first time, Ithaca College’s Dining team participated in the contest independently, winning both Best Vegetarian/Vegan Chili and the People's Choice Award.

item.title: Deja View – Revisionist Westerns - The Ithacan
item.description: Hosts Christopher Meadows and Jordan Costolo conclude their discussions of the western film genre by diving into the revisionist western films "3:10 to Yuma" (2007), "Unforgiven" (1992) and "Django Unchained" (2012).

item.title: New head coach Brandon Maguire builds his staff for 2026 season - The Ithacan
item.description: Football head coach Brandon Maguire announced the promotion of three staff members March 19, including naming Will Margraff the new defensive coordinator. Maguire makes his first coaching staff moves after being hired Feb. 3 to succeed Michael Toerper.

item.title: Young core pushes baseball to 7-4 start - The Ithacan
item.description: When reading through the lineup card of the Ithaca College baseball team, three names stick out: first-year outfielders Anthony Mestre and Isaiah Smith and infielder Zach Barron. The three players are regulars in the Bombers’ starting nine.

item.title: Grace Murray finishes career as national champion in floor exercise - The Ithacan
item.description: Senior Grace Murray won a National Collegiate Gymnastics Association individual championship on the floor exercise with a score of 9.850 March 20 in Cortland. Murray closed out her career with a nearly flawless performance and became the first Bomber in seven years to win a first place title and the first on floor since 2011.

item.title: ‘Project Hail Mary’ answers viewers’ prayers - The Ithacan
item.description: Directors Phil Lord and Christopher Miller lead an expert team of creatives to the stars in the highly anticipated adaptation of Andy Weir’s hard sci-fi bestseller “Project Hail Mary.” The movie, which blasted into theaters March 20 with a record-breaking opening weekend, has all the hallmarks of a Weir classic: accurate science, nailbiting tension and shamelessly brilliant characters.

item.title: Pop Off! – "Andor" Episodes, Pt. 2 - The Ithacan
item.description: Host Ethan Kaufman and senior Ray Milburn explore the core differences between freedom and oppression and dive into the "Star Wars" franchise's most emotionally punishing sequence as they finish ranking their favorite episodes of "Andor."
